journalist.title: Ipswich reshapes its spine after promotion
journalist.body: Two confirmed signings have arrived to rebuild the defensive line before the opener.

influencer.body: Cautious optimism around the rebuild; the room likes the business but wants to see it on grass.

insider.body: From Fulham to Ipswich Town; confirmed — "The move for Issa Diop is done and the paperwork is filed."

tone: Reflective, economical and quietly evocative. Use a light metaphor only when it clarifies the reading.
